whatIsGenerativeAI.question: What is generative AI?
whatIsGenerativeAI.answer: Generative artificial intelligence is a technology capable of creating original content, such as text, images or even code, from pre-existing data. It is used to automate tasks, improve creativity and optimize processes in various sectors of activity.

whoAreTrainings.question: Who are your training courses for?
whoAreTrainings.answer: Our training courses are aimed at all profiles: managers, employees, entrepreneurs, students and individuals. We adapt the content and pedagogy according to the level and specific needs of each participant.

howLongTraining.question: How long do your training courses last?
howLongTraining.answer: The duration varies depending on the type of training: from a few hours for awareness to several days for in-depth training. We also offer tailor-made support that can extend over several weeks.

trainingFormats.question: What training formats are offered?
trainingFormats.answer: We offer face-to-face, online (videoconference) and hybrid training. We adapt to your geographical and organizational constraints to offer you the best learning experience.

followUpAfterTraining.question: Is there follow-up after training?
followUpAfterTraining.answer: Yes, we offer post-training support to help you put into practice the knowledge acquired. This can include Q&A sessions, mentoring or technical support depending on your needs.

whyChooseMadinIA.question: Why choose Madin.IA?
whyChooseMadinIA.answer: Madin.IA combines technical expertise, adapted pedagogical approach and knowledge of the local market. We are based in Martinique and understand the specificities of Caribbean companies while having a global vision of generative AI.

hero.title: RS7138 - Integrating AI into training consultant missions
hero.subtitle: Professional certification to integrate generative artificial intelligence into training consultant activities

objectives.title: Objectives and context of the certification
objectives.description1: This certification attests to skills related to the integration of generative artificial intelligence (GAI) into training consultant activities. This integration concerns several phases of the training process: pedagogical design, animation, evaluation, regulatory and administrative management and compliance with quality requirements, particularly respect for the Qualiopi framework.
objectives.description2: This system is aimed at experienced training consultants working in companies or continuing or initial training organizations. The skills acquired are applicable and transferable to any GAI tool, thus allowing sector professionals to develop their current and future employability.

needsAnalysis.title: Needs analysis
needsAnalysis.description: Analyze learner needs to define operational and evaluable objectives for a training pathway, taking into account the context and particularities of the learner's situation.

pathwayOptimization.title: Pathway optimization
pathwayOptimization.description: Optimize a training pathway meeting previously defined operational objectives, using generative artificial intelligence tools for pedagogical design.
